environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in Step Functions workflow. The LaunchDarkly flag 'step-functions.callback-internal-resolution' is set to TRUE for all users in the 'production' environment segment. Lambda runs in a VPC with access to the EC2 metadata service (IMDSv1 enabled). No egress filtering on the Lambda security group. The flag was enabled during a service mesh migration 3 months ago and left on.
